action.objective: Verify c2c3 as the reserved candidate, then compare with one alternative at shared depth.
action.rationale: Broad search depth 1 is cutoff and shallow; no move is commit-ready. c2c3 is the reserved suggestion with an exact -192 but only depth 1, so it needs single-candidate verification up to max depth using the reserved 2000 nodes. This also builds the comparison evidence needed before committing.
